methods: Manual complete implementation reading across 27 core/gateway files, including authentication, receipt recovery, transport admission, scheduling and workspace proofs.

All 40 files parsed with installed rolldown AST; 57712 nodes, 128 test/group declarations; imports, side effects and assertions inventoried. Manual test review of authentication, HTTP/WebSocket, dispatch, retention, automation, worker lease, worktree and acknowledgement fixtures.
Local in-memory Ledger probe uses the actual receiptResult provider projection and confirms 84 valid 827085-byte recovery results. No external service or production mutation.

findings.title: Recovered receipts bypass the total journal byte budget
findings.description: reserve releases its maximum-size reservation when an operation settles unknown; confirm and confirmWorkspace enforce only the individual receipt size. Later durable positive recovery can grow many small unknown rows beyond the 64 MiB live budget. The isolated probe records 69475140 bytes; continuing this path can also exceed the 80 MiB export bound. Repeated unknown operations can be accumulated across stop-confirmed recovery. Accepted and unknown evidence must never be evicted or re-dispatched to reclaim capacity.
findings.limitations: Direct actual Ledger/projection reproduction; no end-to-end manager transport fault injection performed for this capacity issue.
